instruction: Buy me 2 desk organizers on amazon of at least 4.3 product rating and 4.1 seller rating for my work address. They do not have to be identical.
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. The product is modeled as one abstract desk-organizer product discovered by search_products with product_type and min rating filters, so any product it returns is 'qualified'; buying quantity 2 of one qualifying product satisfies 'they do not have to be identical'. clear_cart is modeled as a prerequisite to adding to cart so the order contains only the desk organizer(s) and the total ordered quantity is exactly 2. supervisor.show_addresses gives the work-address text used to pick the matching amazon address (no address is added/updated/deleted). Ratings and quantity are discrete objects; the goal demands one new order containing the qualified product with quantity 2 shipped to the work address, then task completion (complete_task carries no answer since the task is not a question).

plan: (amazon-place-order payment-card-1 work-address amazon-token order-1 desk-organizer-product quantity-2)
